correctness.rationale: For n≥3 over algebraically closed arbitrary-characteristic k, the affine lattice of crown-edge polytope P_n is saturated by integral transportation. The inequalities x_i,y_i≥0, sums=1 and x_i+y_i≤1 exhaust facets. Each edge vertex makes at most two h_i=1−x_i−y_i active, so a face with one diagonal facet has two arms and smooth generic interior unless contained in a row/column star; two active diagonal facets force a reverse-edge segment. The respective normal cones are nonsimplicial at row stars and reverse-edge segments, and all other cones are unimodular; hence the *reduced* singular support is exactly 2n row/column P^{n−2} plus C(n,2) reverse-edge lines. The transverse saturated generators (e_i,0),(e_i,1) give rank-one 2×(n−1) and 2×(2n−4) determinantal cones of multiplicity n−1 and 2n−4; coordinate supports give exact incidence. Does not assert global nonreduced singular scheme.
